data.synopsis:
I'm the daughter of a Duke?!
While locked up in a prison cell, Eluana Vita awakens her alchemy powers and later finds out she's the daughter of a Duke! However, she's in for a rude awakening when she realizes the royal life isn't what she thought it'd be. Join Eluana on her journey to find the peaceful life she's always wanted.

(Source: Manta)

data.title: Nushen You Dian Ling
data.synopsis:
Yao Ling and Hu Xiaozhen, who parted ways due to a misunderstanding in childhood, reunited in the academy after they grew up. The infatuated female protagonist hopes to continue writing a sweet journey with the male protagonist, but due to the appearance of the mysterious administrator, Ma Shen, "accidents" occur frequently. Under the lure of Ma Shen's plan, the two became acting administrators and they help spirits to realize their long-cherished dreams, in order to continue their progress in love. Through the experience of missions again and again, the relationship between Hu and Yao becomes deeper and deeper, and they are moving towards the road of righteousness. But the true purpose of Ma Shen gradually implicates the operating laws behind the world, and more mysteries, and dangers lie between the hero and heroine. 

(Source: Bilibili, Google translated & edited)

data.title: Shashou Gu De
data.synopsis:
Goode was once a core member of the mysterious organization ARGUS, but now he has shed its shadow and, along with his naive and innocent sidekick Sura, makes a living by taking on various jobs and earning corresponding rewards. The two always seem to get thankless tasks, from outsmarting aliens to racing bicycles with a shaving maniac… Goode's two mischievous friends—a PhD student skilled in all sorts of useless inventions and a vain, witty guy—always seem to get in the way, making things even more chaotic. Despite this, the "trouble killer" Goode, along with his three eccentric companions, tirelessly completes job after job, helping many people in distress.

(Source: iQIYI, Google translated)

data.title: Jian Gu
data.synopsis:
Ning Yi, a commoner from Xiling, possesses a special gluttonous physique. He relies on Pei Fan, who is burdened with a blood feud, for survival. Later, he becomes entangled with the mysterious girl Xu Qingyan through the rare treasure bone flute. Xu Zang, a sword immortal from Shu Mountain, teaches Ning Yi the ultimate swordsmanship, and the bone flute helps him achieve the honor of being a swordsman, bearing the responsibility of saving the world and bringing light.

(Source: iQIYI, Google translated)

data.title: Ban Shen Zhi Jing
data.synopsis:
Xia Qiu, the young master of the Shenzhao Sect, returns to the country at the invitation of his elder brother Xia Chun, only to unexpectedly discover strange research in a secret chamber. To uncover Xia Chun's secrets, he ventures to Fuyu Pool, but is persecuted by his brother and forced into becoming a sacrifice to the ancient ferocious beast Feilian. By a twist of fate, Feilian resides within Xia Qiu's body, and he loses his original powers. 

He is rescued by a chance encounter with a young girl named Long Yan. Upon waking, under the arrangement of Qing Chou, the acting head of the Long family, he disguises himself as Long Ze, the youngest son of the Long family, beginning a new life and adventure. Along the way, Long Ze encounters many companions and gradually experiences familial love and friendship he has never known before. The good times didn't last long. The immense power within him caused frequent crises, and the constantly emerging power struggles repeatedly injured or even killed his friends…

Ultimately, the ever-growing Long Ze reconciled with the power within him, successfully averting the greatest crisis and rescuing his companions who had been kidnapped by evil forces. However, the mysterious figure controlling the entire chessboard removed his mask, revealing himself to be his brother, Xia Chun, and even greater mysteries began to gather…

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

data.synopsis:
Shuwawan! chronicles the family life of real-life photographer and essayist Harumichi Saitou. Saitou and his wife are both deaf, his children are both hearing, and the family communicates in sign language. The anime draws on Saitou's own Ikuji Manga Nikki (Child-rearing Manga Diary) work.

(Source: ANN)
